name: fabflows
description: Routes work from an expensive lead model to tool-scoped worker agents (explorer and researcher on Haiku, editor and test-runner on Sonnet, refuter and investigator on Opus) and makes the lead re-verify what they report. fabflows:build is a deterministic loop in which an Opus builder implements a spec and a fresh reviewer returns ACCEPT or REWORK. The brainstorming skill turns a rough idea into that spec, the fabflows-setup and ticket skills keep it in a GitHub Issues, Jira or Linear ticket, and the trace skill writes an audit trace report of every merged change. An ACTIVE guard hook asks before package installs and package runners such as npx, denies them in workers, and blocks default-branch commits, destructive commands and credential reads and writes; it fails open.
